# Versions of: Pennies against dollars

1 published version of [Pennies against dollars: what our agents actually cost at Web Summit, the swarm that ran 216 model calls on four open-weight models for under seven cents where the same tokens on a frontier model would have cost about two dollars, newsroom days of hundreds of API-equivalent dollars, almost all of it agents re-reading their own sessions, and the lesson that context is the cost and starting again is cheaper than remembering](../pennies-against-dollars.md). The current one is **v1.0.0**.

v1.0.0 is the article as first published. A change to its text (title, abstract or body) is the next minor version, v1.1.0; a change only to its other details (a LinkedIn link, the release it belongs to) is the next patch, v1.0.1. The list is read from the site's git history at every build, so it cannot be edited by hand and cannot leave a version out. Views extracted from an article, such as the Five readers, are not part of its text and do not change its version.
